finally:

        os.unlink(name)

tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile, time
p = Path('main.go')
content = '''package main

import (
	\"math/rand\"
	\"os\"
	\"text/template\"
)

func main() {
	tmpl := template.Must(template.New(\"greeting\").Parse(\"Hello World {{.}}\\\\n\"))
	if err := tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, rand.Intn(100)); err "'!= nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
'"'''
fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.main.go.', dir='.')
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
        f.write(content)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(name, p)
    os.utime(p, ns=(time.time_ns(), time.time_ns()))
finally:
    if os.path.exists(name):
        os.unlink(name)
PY
git diff -- main.go go.mod go.sum"
